name: Pikachu Jet BC2 (ピカチュウジェット BC2)
description: Skymark's second Pokémon jet (737-800 JA73NG): a light-blue sea wave from the nose to the tail along the lower fuselage and over the cabin, a large Wailord along the forward fuselage, Pikachu riding a Magikarp-shaped float aft, Shaymin (Sky Forme) by the nose, bubbles and clouds; white crown; Skymark's navy fin and star kept, a 'Pokémon' logo at its root; small 'SKY' with the star block under the cockpit.

sources.note: BC1 (JA73AB) in service from 2021-06-21, BC2 (737-800 JA73NG) from 2022-05-30; BC1's flight-tag key ring sold on board from 2026-06-01.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: Pokémon aircraft
sources.note: BC2 shows Pikachu, Wailord, Magikarp and Shaymin (Sky Forme) in a sea scene; planned to fly about five years.

logos.description: Wailord, Pikachu, Magikarp and Shaymin over a light-blue sea along the fuselage (Pokémon artwork, never drawn from here).

notes: Described in words only: the open photos (2022-08-30, 2023-02-28, left side) are from ahead and from far, and the design covers the whole cabin; the right side has no open photo. Named in May 2026 (Aviation Wire), planned to fly about five years from 2022, so current. Its sea fields could be drawn from a side-on open photo.
